title: Catalog Normalization

selection_basis.strict_order: OARC-01 → OARC-02 → OARC-03 → OARC-04 → OARC-05 → OARC-06 → OARC-07
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: GPR-01 and MRCS-16 remain independently selected_not_started.

objective: Normalize the real source-backed Vehicles, Mecha, Spacecraft/Starship, Bases/Facilities and associated component/item catalogs into existing MRCS/MIB-14/D17-compatible identities and references with stable provenance, while leaving source-insufficient facts explicit.
acceptance: Enumerate the governed operational-asset source registries and source counts/hashes used by normalization.
Assign each normalizable source record a stable source identity, provenance and explicit existing-owner target classification without creating a new OARC canonical catalog.
Use OARC02 owner-reference syntax for records that bind to existing MIB-14 operational/module/facility definitions or normalized owner definitions.
Preserve explicit source slot/component/compatibility evidence even when a current MIB-14 field cannot operationalize it.
Do not infer mecha/spacecraft parent-component relations, compatibility, capacities, system presence or operating envelopes from names/grouping/missing values.
Classify incomplete/unmappable rows visibly for later specialization/coverage rather than filling gaps.
Keep MERA/MBES reserved runtime authority untouched.
boundaries: OARC-03 normalizes source content; it does not implement OARC-04 specialization profiles, OARC-05 containment, OARC-06 golden workflows or OARC-07 final certification.
MRCS remains reusable definition-authoring authority; MIB-14 remains operational configuration authority; D17 remains live Asset truth.
PPIA-04 CSV-first vehicle/mecha/spacecraft source authority and no-name-similarity parentage rule remain binding.
OARC02-GAP-01 and OARC02-GAP-02 remain visible; normalization may preserve evidence but cannot invent operational semantics.
GPR and MRCS lane state remains independent.
next_action: On an OARC-specific owner Continue, fresh-read OARC-03, OARC01.AUTHORITY_HANDOFF.v1, OARC02.DEFINITION_BRIDGE.v1, PPIA-04/source coverage authorities and the actual operational-asset source registries, then execute the complete bounded catalog-normalization tranche.
